out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: 1) Tuna 2) White tuna (escolar) 3) mackerel 4) squid 5) scallop 6) surf clam 7) prawn 8) salmon, flying fish, smelt roe
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. CONTACT THE SUPPLIER TO OBTAIN A NEW PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER THAT LISTS ALL FISH/SEAFOOD THAT IS OFFERED RAW OR UNDERCOOKED. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in a unplugged rice cooker: white rice (84f) 2) in a 2DR reach in, bar cooler: half and half (44-48f) 3) in the home-style refrigerator, server station: cut tofu (49f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: The lunch menu was observed with no consumer advisory for any of the Raw fish.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PIC UPDATED THE MENU DURING THE INSPECTION. LUNCH MENU NOW HAS THE CORRECT CONSUMER ADVISORY FOR RAW FISH.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Observed home-use pesticides, Combat gel bait and Ortho spray, being stored in dry storage and behind coolers
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED THE PESTICIDES. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO ALLOW THE LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR TO PREFORM THE PEST CONTROL SERVICES ONLY. DO NOT USE HOME-USE PESTICIDES IN A COMMERCIAL FACILITY. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED TWO CONTAINERS OF COMMERCIAL-USE PESTICIDE, SHOCKWAVE, BEING STORED UNDER THE HAND SINK AT THE SUSHI BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED THE PESTICIDES. A LICENSED PESTICIDE APPLICATOR IS THE ONLY PERSON ALLOWED TO APPLY COMMERCIAL, RESTRICTED USE PESTICIDES.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed commercially reduced oxygen packaged Raw ground tuna thawing in the walk-in cooler without being cut open
violations.corrective_action: EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO CUT OPEN ALL FROZEN REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGED FISH TO THAW PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) Home-style refrigerator, server station
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. REPLACE HOME-STYLE REFRIGERATOR WITH A COMMERCIAL REFRIGERATOR. COOLER MUST BE ABLE TO KEEP FOOD AT 41f.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed an accumulation of food debris and grease around the following: 1) grease trap at the wok station 2) under the wok prep top cooler 3) under the fryer
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: A parasite destruction letter was not provided by management for the Raw salmon
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. PROVIDE EHS WITH THE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR THE SALMON. DISCONTINUE TO USE THE PARTICULAR SUPPLIER IF A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER CANNOT BE PROVIDED. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) observed Raw fish being stored on top of a container of pickled ginger in the walk-in cooler; 2) observed Raw beef and Raw chicken being stored over Ready-to-eat food in the 2DR prep top appetizer cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO MOVE RAW ANIMAL PRODUCTS TO A LOCATION WHERE IT WILL NOT CONTAMINATE READY-TO-EAT FOODS. PIC STARTED MOVING RAW ANIMAL PRODUCTS TO THE APPROPRIATE LOCATION. SEE PREVENTING CROSS CONTAMINATION HAND OUT. SAAO THAI & SUSHI (Inspection Date: 01/30/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: Observed inconsistent date marking on prepared foods throughout the facility
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO DATE MARK ALL FOODS THAT ARE BEING STORED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS. USE OF DISCARD WITHIN 7 DAYS. SEE DATE MARKING FACT SHEET.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed several spray bottles of cleaning products being stored next to clean dishes.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC MOVED THE CLEANING PRODUCTS TO THE CHEMICAL STORAGE AREA.

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Observed a large spray bottle of Ortho home-use pesticide being stored behind the bar.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED THE PESTICIDE. CONTACT YOUR LICENSED PEST CONTROL COMPANY TO INCREASE SERVICES AS NEEDED. DO NOT USE HOME-USE PESTICIDES.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed a small box of personal care items, such as vitamins and pain relievers, being stored behind the sushi counter.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. MOVE PERSONAL CARE ITEMS AWAY FROM ALL FOOD PREPARATION AREAS (ie: EMPLOYEE BELONGINGS, OFFICE)

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food (ie: oil, bags of rice, beverages, etc.) being stored directly on the floor throughout the facility
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD OFF OF THE FLOOR TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers of white vinegar and peeled garlic were observed being reused to store sauces and fried garnishes
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. REPLACE MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS WITH NSF-APPROVED STORAGE CONTAINERS. MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS ARE NOT MEANT TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: Observed aluminum foil, plastic wrap, and paper towels being used as liners at the wok station and the fry station
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. REMOVE LINERS TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: 1) 2DR prep top wok station; 2) sides of fryer; 3) knobs of oven; 4) handles of all coolers.
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed an accumulation of food debris, dirt, and grease on the floor and corners of the wok station and ice machine area.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED. PREFORM A DEEP CLEANING AND MAINTAIN A ROUTINE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed small flat top grill, tool box, power drill, potted plants, and large speaker being stored in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. REMOVE AND CONSOLIDATE EQUIPMENT TO REDUCE HARBORAGE CONDITIONS.
